answer: Weight each identity by scarce one-per-human attestation instead of by name count. A newcomer needs distinct established vouchers, each staking a bond against fraud. Fleets fail three ways: vouchers run dry since honest holders ration stake; a broken vouch burns the voucher's bond too; and reputation flows through the vouch, so a fake tide drags its sponsors down. Sybils must outbid real collateral, making a thousand-name echo pay a thousand forfeitable bonds while honest yarrow growers pay little.
